findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: game_get_messages, list_related_servers, xchain_build_settle · Private data: game_evm_commit_guess, game_evm_committed, game_evm_match_status, game_evm_reveal_guess, game_find_evm_match, game_get_messages, game_send_message, register_wallet, xchain_build_create_match, xchain_build_create_xmatch, xchain_build_lock, xchain_build_refund, xchain_build_settle, xchain_commit_guess, xchain_find_match, xchain_match_status, xchain_supported_chains · Public sink: game_commit_guess, game_evm_commit_guess, game_evm_committed, game_evm_reveal_guess, game_find_match, game_reveal_guess, game_send_message, game_submit_tx, xchain_build_create_xmatch, xchain_build_lock, xchain_build_lock_xmatch, xchain_build_refund, xchain_build_refund_xmatch, xchain_gameplay_status, xchain_sign_checkpoint · Destructive: xchain_supported_chains.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
